contact_map.status: Discrete contact-map orbit diagnostic. It alternates contact jumps with directed centerline advance; it does not yet test a specular-reflection law and is therefore not by itself a billiard-orbit proof.

symmetry.interpretation: Geometric embedding proxy only; not a proof of topological amphichirality.

epsilon_comparison.status: The fixed-epsilon score is the primary comparative quantity. The minimum over epsilon is retained only as a smoothing-sensitivity diagnostic.
